rows.details: Memo No. GU/UGC/Research Proj/S.T. Radar Centre/IITM-M.E.Sc/2026/929-32, dated 16/11/26
Joint Research Project by Gauhati University, Guwahati and IIT Madras, Chennai to improve prediction and predictability of Indian monsoon using AI/ML methods
Monsoon Mission-III, Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology under Ministry of Earth Sciences
Initially for one year, extendable up to three years
₹67,000 per month + HRA (as per MOES norms)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible Indian nationals. The essential qualifications for Research Associate-III (RAIII) are: Ph.D. in Atmospheric Science, Meteorology, Climate Science, Physics, Earth System Science, Environmental Science. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis may also apply, provided they produce the provisional degree certificate before joining (subject to MoES norms). Consistently good academic record with demonstrated research potential. Demonstrated research experience in one or more of the following: Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP); Climate Modelling (CMIP, WRF, RegCM or similar); Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning for weather and climate applications; Scientific programming using Python. At least one or two years Postdoctoral experience. Demonstrated independent research experience with research publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals. Experience in processing satellite, reanalysis and climate model datasets. Experience in application of AI/ML models to weather and climate predictions. Experience in supervising research students or project personnel. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate-III fellowship is ₹67,000 per month, with HRA paid in addition as per MoES norms. The appointments are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The duration is initially for one year, extendable up to three years based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: Gauhati University Research Associate-III (RAIII) Job Description
content_sections.text: The objective of the project is to improve prediction and predictability of Indian monsoon on all scales ranging from extreme rainfall events to inter annual variability using AI/ML methods, and the candidate is expected to contribute to realizing these objectives. The work listed in the notice: Conduct independent research on AI-based weather prediction and climate modelling. Develop, train and validate AI/ML models for rainfall and monsoon prediction. Analyse large-scale meteorological and climate datasets. Publish research findings in reputed journals. Assist in mentoring project staff and research scholars. Contribute to project reports and other research deliverable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gauhati University Research Associate-III (RAIII)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed curriculum vitae. Attach copies of educational certificates and mark sheets, proof of age, experience certificates (if any), list of publications (for PDF applicants) and other relevant supporting documents. Send the application by email to [email protected] with CC to [email protected] . Write the subject line as: Application for Research Associate-III . Send the email by 30 November 2026, the last date for submission of applications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The notice does not mention the interview date or mode.
